description: The stable identifier for the record's Subject, exactly as it appears in the source content. WHY this is the pack's only Observation: it is required by the Event definition (so every Event has a fact to key on) and it carries the 'entityType' hint (so it can also serve as the Event's primaryEntity mapping) — the smallest Observation catalogue that still exercises both cross-checks the loader performs (an Event's requiredObservations and its primaryEntity.observationSchemaKey). A real pack authors one Observation schema per distinct fact it needs to extract, not one Observation total.
